name: explicit_namba_plan_beats_ambiguous_skill_mention
input: Use $namba-plan for @plan and create the next feature SPEC
rationale: Explicit Namba command skills remain the workflow router even when Codex unified mention search could surface similarly named skills.

name: plugin_reference_is_readiness_not_install
input: Explain Codex 0.131 plugin marketplace and share checkout readiness for Namba
rationale: Plugin and marketplace references should be described as optional readiness paths, not as installation requirements.

name: file_and_directory_mentions_do_not_replace_namba_router
input: Check @README.md and @.agents/skills before deciding whether this is namba plan or namba harness
rationale: File and directory mentions provide context for Codex, but Namba still routes by explicit workflow intent.

name: mixed_mentions_require_disambiguation
input: Use @namba, @Browser, and @.namba/specs to do the right thing
rationale: Mixed skill, plugin, and directory mentions should not silently become a Namba command or a plugin installation flow.
